title: Bann Appeal

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Hello,

Your IP on this account (TheKipperFlipper) seems to match perfectly with the account "specopskip".
You were banned because you accessed the server on an alternate account while banned on another.

You can try to appeal in a few months. I'm going to let you know that ban evading is strictly not allowed, and will drastically reduce your chances of being appealed.

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
